title: 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: When does WCAG require a correct reading sequence?
choices: For every visual position regardless of meaning
elements.feedback: A correct programmatic sequence is required when order affects meaning.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: What can CSS visual reordering leave unchanged?
elements.feedback: Visual layout can change while DOM order stays the same.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: How can you investigate reading order?
choices: Read the DOM sequence with a screen reader
elements.correctAnswer: Read the DOM sequence with a screen reader
elements.feedback: Reading the source sequence helps reveal order problems.
